Special report // Autonomous futures

We could have had utopia.

The machines were supposed to make survival easier. The question is not whether intelligence will change the world. It is who gets to decide what that intelligence is built to do.

The editorial position

Technology is never just technology. It is a record of who was protected, who was ignored, and who was allowed to imagine the future.

Glitchbot Magazine is an independent creative publication covering artificial intelligence, machines, power, tenderness, labor, survival, and the weird emotional weather between humans and systems.
